      public UtilizationCoverageReport.Builder evidence(InstalledEquipmentCapacityEvidence value)
      Supplies one immutable constraint snapshot already sampled at an accepted operating point.

      This path never resamples live equipment and is intended for optimizer, envelope and lifecycle handoffs after the mutable process model has been restored to its baseline.
